target.title: fix: video media understanding runs without a selected model
target.body:
## What Problem This Solves

Fixes an issue where users relying on automatic video media understanding could select a video-capable provider without a model and then execute video description with `model` unset.

## Why This Change Was Made

Video auto-selection now mirrors the model requirement already enforced for image understanding: active and key-selected video providers use their provider default video model, and providers without a resolvable video model are skipped instead of being run with an undefined model. The change stays within media-understanding provider entry resolution and does not change provider metadata, auth, or configured explicit model precedence.

## User Impact

Video attachments can be described through auto-selected providers such as Moonshot without silently dropping the model id. Existing explicit video model configuration continues to take precedence, and adjacent audio auto-selection behavior is unchanged.

## Evidence

- Validation `runner-video` passed:

  ```text
   RUN  v4.1.8 [local path redacted]

   Test Files  1 passed (1)
        Tests  4 passed (4)
  ```

- Validation `runner-auto-audio` passed:

   Test Files  2 passed (2)
        Tests  13 passed (13)
  ```

- Validation `format-check-focused` passed:

  All matched files use the correct format.
  ```
